int.ui.bounty_text: The weekly bounty kinds are part of the running season: the weeks still to come are drawn from the new list, so the season's standings can change.
int.ui.cleanup_keep_runs: Runs kept in the live table
int.ui.cleanup_last: Last clean-up {at} by {by}: {archived} runs archived, {kept} unfinished money rows kept, {audit} old audit lines removed ({ms} ms).
int.ui.cleanup_never: No clean-up has run since the last start.
int.ui.cleanup_now_text: Archives old runs and removes old audit lines now, the same as the daily reset does. Unfinished payments and item rewards always stay. At most once every 10 minutes.
int.ui.cleanup_skipped: It was skipped because another admin job was running.
int.ui.cleanup_subtitle: Archiving old runs and trimming the audit log, every day at the daily reset.
int.ui.recheck_all_text: Checks every officer's badges against their saved runs, and gives or takes away what changed. Badges an admin granted or revoked by hand stay as they are.
int.ui.source_short: With the department accounts as the source, some departments cannot pay what they already owe. Rows that cannot be paid become unfunded (final). Add money to those accounts first.
int.ui.source_text: Payments will come from each department's account. These are the balances and the held or pending pay each one would then pay.
int.ui.trial_text: {n} of {checked} missions would not load with this value. They stay off until the value is changed back.
